title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua: I trust this kid's heart

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua: I trust this kid's heart
sources.description: The Rams HC said at the annual league meeting on Monday that he'll continue to put his arm around Nacua and help the young WR grow as a player and person.
